IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNTPRODUCT_OTHR') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_OTHR;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm       
INTO DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_OTHR             
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP')

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTHR') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTHR;
END;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(int,AccountSK)
    ,convert(varchar,AccountID)
    ,convert(int,ProductSK)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(int,BankSK)
    ,convert(varchar,BranchSK)  
    ,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)        
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_OTHR 
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(int,AccountSK)
    ,convert(varchar,AccountID)
    ,convert(int,ProductSK)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(int,BankSK)
    ,convert(varchar,BranchSK)  
    ,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)                    
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP') 
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
    ,TGT.SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTHR FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTHR DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
JOIN DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_OTHR SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP') ;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_TRU DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRU SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'TRU';

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRU') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRU;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm    
INTO DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRU      
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'  
GROUP BY
DDA.AccountSK
,
BCAFP.CustomerAccountId
,DDP.ProductSK
,BCAFP.ProductID
,DDB.BankSK
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode

UPDATE TGT

 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_TRY DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRY') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRY;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)

SELECT  DISTINCT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BTTFP.FinancialProductId) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BTTFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode  --change from dimaccount
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm  
INTO DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_TRY                       
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTrade BTT
LEFT JOIN BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct BTTFP ON BTTFP.TradeId = BTT.TradeId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = BTTFP.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BTTFP.FinancialProductId = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BankSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
WHERE BTTFP.SourceSystemCode <> 'DEP' AND  BTTFP.SourceSystemCode ='TRY'

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNTPRODUCT_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_DEP;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO DW.ACCOUNTPRODUCT_DEP   
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
